page.overview:
Who is Corrin III?

Emperor Corrin III was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 883–889 AG), succeeding his mother Alia I Salusa as ruler of the Corrino Imperium.

Corrin was succeeded in 889 by his son Elrood III.
